business_snapshot: Infosys Ltd is a leading global technology services and consulting company providing end-to-end IT solutions, digital transformation, and cloud services to Global 2000 enterprises. Its revenue mix spans multiple industry verticals including Financial Services, Manufacturing, Energy, Retail, Communication, Hi-Tech, and Life Sciences.
trajectory_summary: Top-line revenue has expanded steadily over multi-year periods driven by large deal wins and accelerating AI adoption, crossing ₹49,244 Cr in Sep 2026. Meanwhile, operating margins have held stable at 24% (or 21% under IFRS reporting) due to disciplined execution of margin-expansion initiatives like Project Maximus.

narrative_vs_numbers.management_narrative: Guided to a revenue growth outlook of 1.5% to 3.0% in constant currency terms for FY27, highlighting robust traction in large deals and strong enterprise demand for generative AI capabilities.
narrative_vs_numbers.actual_numbers_delivered: Sales: ₹48,211 Cr, OPM: 24.0%, Net Profit: ₹7,775 Cr.

narrative_vs_numbers.management_narrative: Narrowed annual revenue growth guidance to 1% to 2% in constant currency, reflecting softer volumes, ongoing pricing pressures, and heightened macroeconomic uncertainty while emphasizing a record $5.2 billion in large deal TCV and 10.5% AI revenue contribution.
narrative_vs_numbers.actual_numbers_delivered: Sales: ₹49,244 Cr, OPM: 24.0% (21.0% IFRS), Net Profit: ₹7,838 Cr.

cash_quality.cfo_to_pat_ratio_3yr: Strong cash generation, with multi-year operating cash flows matching or exceeding net profit (e.g., Mar 2026 CFO at ₹33,986 Cr vs PAT of ₹29,474 Cr, and stable 101% CFO-to-EBITDA share conversion).
cash_quality.working_capital_trend: Debtor days have remained range-bound between 63 and 72 days (72 days reported in Sep 2026), maintaining a stable cash conversion cycle and working capital discipline.
cash_quality.leverage_and_roce: Borrowings remain minimal and well-controlled relative to massive equity reserves, while ROCE has expanded and stabilized at elite levels around 38% to 40%.
cash_quality.diagnostic_verdict: Accounting profits convert exceptionally well into free cash flows and robust cash and investments reserves (₹45,232 Cr as of Sep 2026), reflecting high financial quality.

forward_guidance: Revenue growth guidance for FY27 narrowed to 1.0% to 2.0% in constant currency terms.
Operating margin guidance maintained at 20.0% to 22.0% for the full year.
Large deal momentum expected to continue with specific mega deals set to contribute over 1% revenue growth in the upcoming financial year.
bull_case: Rapid scaling of AI-led services (Topaz Fabric, agentic workflows), capturing 10.5% of total revenue with 29% sequential growth.
Robust large deal wins totaling $5.2 billion in Q2 FY27, featuring high net-new components ($2 billion+ mega deal) providing multi-quarter revenue visibility.
Elite return ratios with ROCE at 40.0% and ROE at 31.9%, backed by disciplined capital allocation and substantial free cash flow generation.
bear_case: Downward revision of revenue growth guidance (1% to 2%) underlines persistent softness in discretionary spending across Retail and Hi-Tech verticals.
Intense competitive pressures causing pricing compression and challenging traditional service line billings.
Upcoming wage hikes and compensation adjustments in H2 pose headwinds that require continuous offsetting via cost optimization programs like Project Maximus.
primary_sources_used: Audited Consolidated Financial Statements & Multi-Year Tables (Infosys Ltd)
NSE Filing: Outcome of Board Meeting (23-Oct-2026)
